Now catch the race

Line, conditional and fetch breakpoints

This search box shows results for an old query.

Breakpoints show you why.

The user types re, then react.

Each input event starts a fetch to the server.

The react response comes back first.

The slow re response comes back last and overwrites the list.

A console.log prints only the values you guessed in advance.

A breakpoint pauses the code,

so you can read every variable in scope.

In the Sources panel, you set a breakpoint.

DevTools pauses before that line runs.

You read the Scope, Watch and Call Stack panes,

then step or resume.

Next, you set the breakpoints yourself and catch the stale response.
